title: One map, exact scaling
text: The collective map C(x)=x+L²/G reduces to an integer γ-coordinate with a one-step law. Every persistent orbit closes on a finite state set and scales exactly: x_{n+P}=ρ²x_n.

title: A carry calculus
text: The γ-dynamics is an odometer: carries are complete, eventual carries are prime powers, and the decoupled odometer law gives their exact schedule.

title: One active prime
text: In the eventual regime of every persistent orbit exactly one prime is active. Two saturated clocks have coprime periods, and the scaling factor is a prime power.

title: Selection and certification
text: A minimax selection theorem and a quotient-residue formula identify the surviving carry exactly. Static certification of survivors (S3–S5) is proved for prime g.

title: Effective transient bounds
text: The reset-descent bound κ(γ₀) is sharp, attained for every κ=1…11. Class-counting, polynomial and dynamic-G bounds make the transient length explicit.
